chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi on Nibbit, then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, dealing 17 damage and gaining 3 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Water's Edge followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, which would deal 15 damage but gain no Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up playing Water's Edge and therefore left Nibbit alive at 7 HP rather than spending that card's Hydro application; within the printed information, it gave up nothing in immediate damage or protection compared with the alternative.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, the 3 Block from Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi could have been irrelevant, though I would still favor this line on the printed damage totals; an intent requiring a different immediate priority could have changed the choice.
